title: experiment link block/1
description: The A/B setup a world share link carries as `xp` of its payload: a name (at most 80 characters), the metric ids, the object ids, the primary object, the one variable changed between the runs as [key, from, to] and whether a second variable was confirmed. The recorded samples never travel in a link. js/experiments/shareExperiment.js readExperimentBlock() is the authority and is lenient: it keeps what it can use and drops a member that is not the right kind, so the schema, which states what the writer writes, refuses what the reader drops. FORMATS.md lists it.
